name: Mallet Fracture of the Finger
definition: Bony avulsion injury at the dorsal base of the distal phalanx associated with terminal extensor tendon dysfunction.

investigations.principle: Finger radiographs assess avulsion size and joint alignment.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Continuous DIP extension splinting for suitable stable injuries
amber: Large articular fragments or volar subluxation may require surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Bony avulsion injury at the dorsal base of the distal phalanx associated with terminal extensor tendon dysfunction.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
